name: LOLO' Shoebox
description: LOLO' Shoebox: a high-performance, privacy-first local toolbox with 41 tools across text, image, security, developer, network and media. Featuring local AI background removal, video frame capture, video-to-GIF conversion, multimedia transcoding, texture packing and distributed network diagnostics. Powered by WebAssembly and client-side AI, it follows the 'Zero Data Upload' principle: files and data stay in the browser.
